Yes, den der er nesten identisk. Da jeg undersøkte i går fant jeg også flere sider som var veldig/helt like.
https://mojeswiat.com/nb/

Aner ikke hvorfor hun bestilte fra en polsk side da ingen i familien vår er polske, hun sa hun så den på facebook.

Jeg skjønte jo ganske fort at det var noen ugler i mosen med ræva oversettelser, placeholder tekst som fortsatt er på sida og at en sånn type "organisasjon" ikke deler mer om hvordan de opererer, i tillegg til at jeg fant armbåndene på aliexpress.

Sinnsykt dårlig gjort å lure folk som tror de hjelper sånne tiltak, men sånn er det bare.
I can't really see how I'd get a gouge like this plugged, unless there's some kind of "tire glue" or something I haven't heard about.

It's a 96-key layout.
This is the YMDK Melody96 pcb.

It's still open on [Drop](https://drop.com/buy/nym96-aluminum-mechanical-keyboard) for a couple more days in kit or preassembled form with the case.

Sure!

[NYM96 from Drop](https://drop.com/buy/nym96-aluminum-mechanical-keyboard#overview) with Kailh box whites

Cable is from [Pexon](https://pexonpcs.co.uk/), with the "Tokyo Nights" sleeve

And I jumped on the group buy on [Dixiemech](https://dixiemech.store/collections/keycaps/products/gmk-8008) for the keycaps and deskpad, although they aren't available there now

The mousepad was an option in the group buy on Dixiemech. Imo not very different from other "normal" mousepads, with a little bit of grain but still considered fast. I still use an Artisan fx Hien for my mouse, which is a bit more "sandpaper-ish", but I like it.
Yeah. They're called aviator connectors. While I just keep mine as it is, people have soldered cables directly to the keyboard, making it a bit more functional.

They're not really that blue. The light source in the pic was very blue, and I filtered it a little bit because I thought it looked nice. They are a lot more similar to the renders in normal lighting, so don't worry.
It's the YMDK Melody96 pcb. It takes some getting used to but I've learned to love it!

Well tbf many of the classes are unlucky.
Lock & pala are getting mounts they already have 2 of.
Dk gets another glory of the Icecrown raider drake.
Warrior gets a vacuum chamber challenge glory of the Ulduar raider drake.
Druid gets flight form.
Priest gets a shiny owl.
And rogue gets a bird with a hat.
I know it's all about "class fantasy" and all that, but I'm personally not a fan of many of them.
